title: A fixed coalition with high influence
statement: Let $n\ge 2$, and let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$ be monotone, with uniform mean between $-99/100$ and $99/100$, inclusive. There is a set $J$ of coordinates, of size at most $20000n/\log n$, such that for at least $99/100$ of uniformly chosen inputs, the coalition controlling $J$ can make the output either sign by changing coordinates in $J$ while leaving all other coordinates fixed.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a monotone function from the $n$ dimensional sign cube to $\{-1,1\}$
The mean of $f$ is at least $-99/100$
The mean of $f$ is at most $99/100$
